text:
maria: Heads-up — planning an RBAC tweak for private deploys next week. Need clarity: when we restrict service account create/patch, how will KMS key rotation events be surfaced to our central audit stream? Also worried netpols might block the remote auditor (auditor.elk) that pulls logs. Anyone run this matrix before? @devon @srinivas

devon: Timeline? If it's next week we should canary in staging. Netpols default-deny so auditor needs explicit egress to kibana/s3 or to the collector endpoint.

srinivas: Quick netpol I used for onprem collector (deny egress except to collector-host):
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-collector-egress
  namespace: monitoring
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: log-forwarder
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: collector
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 9200
```
Run: `kubectl apply -f audit-netpol.yaml`
Note: if using syslog over UDP, allow UDP 514 to collector.

aj: For KMS events — rotation shows up as `kms.rotate` in local audit.log. In private we forward local audit to customer collector; ensure the forwarder SA has the right KMS read permissions. Rotation operations often need `kms:GetPublicKey` + `kms:DescribeKey` for validation. cc: @ops-liz

ops-liz: We have a rotation-runbook (internal) — add post-rotation self-check: run `tooling/kms_test_decrypt --key $KEY_ID`. Also ensure audit-forwarder uses mTLS and writes to a write-ahead log on disk in case egress is temporarily blocked.

sec-bot: ALERT: CVE-2026-0421 affecting collector v1.2.3 detected — upgrade to v1.2.4. Patch details: https://cve.example/2026-0421

maria: Good catch. We'll postpone the RBAC roll until the collector is patched in staging. Can someone assemble a short checklist for the change: SA privileges, netpol egress rules, audit-forwarder health check, rotation verification, and a rollback plan? :thumbsup:

devon: I’ll drop a gist with a checklist: https://gist.github.com/devon/xyz — highlights: 1) minimal SA perms 2) forwarder with mTLS to collector 3) run rotation test job 4) validate audit.log ingestion within 5m window

srinivas: One more for air-gapped installs: we need a "pull" mode where the collector exposes a read-only artifact on a mounted disk that the auditor can scrape offline. Netpols then only need to allow in-cluster traffic (kube-system -> collector).

aj: +1. Temporary fallback if netpol blocks auditor: `kubectl port-forward svc/collector 9200:9200 -n monitoring` — add that to runbook as emergency step.

maria: Thanks all — scheduling a tabletop Thurs 09:30 PT (eng-security, eng-sre, ops). Agenda: RBAC plan, netpol validation, KMS rotation flow, and incident fallback. :calendar:
